_comment: Instance data for core scripts/lesson-carriers.py: where this brain keeps its feedback protocol (the append-only record of operator corrections), which key words open the carrier line of an entry (a line of its own, e.g. `Carrier: <check, gate, script, skill or doc>` or `Carrier: prose, because <why no mechanism fits>` — the latter is a decision, a missing line is the gap), and how an entry heading looks (a regex whose first group is the date). The session-close step and the brain-scan read it. A brain that writes its protocol in another language lists that language's key word here as well. Second source: memories of the types in memory_types name their carrier in metadata.carrier ('<file> :: <phrase>' or 'prose, because ...'); memory_dir overrides the auto-memory folder (empty = the repo's own).
